data.gender_notes: Hebaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'haba' which means 'to give'. The name Hebaah is an expression of giving and receiving, referring to the blessings of life and the generosity of Allah. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the best of gifts are the blessings of knowledge, wisdom, and faith. The name Hebaah carries the meaning “Gift, Present” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hebaah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, present and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the blessings and gifts bestowed upon us by Allah.
data.etymology: Hebaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Present.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hebaah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
